newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia denies selling multimedia arm.
newsitem.headline: Nokia denies selling multimedia arm.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said on Friday a report in daily Turun Sanomat that it may sell its multimedia business was wrong.

"I can tell you it is a totally unfounded story," Nokia spokesman Seppo Harkonen told Reuters in response to the report, which said Nokia was close to finalising the sale of a plant in Turku and may follow this by selling its multimedia business.
"We are not going to sell any part of multimedia. On the contrary, we just in November enlarged our R&D centre in Turku. We really want to settle down in that area and expand R&D," Harkonen said.

Harkonen said there were other activities in Turku left over from Nokia's television production business which are less relevant to its core business, but did not confirm or deny whether it was in talks to sell these.
Nokia said last June it had agreed to sell its television business to Hong Kong owned Semi-Tech (Global) Ltd, the investment arm of Toronto-based Semi-Tech Corporation .
Turun Sanomat said Nokia and Semi-Tech were in the final stages of talks on the sale of a tuner plant in Turku.
